dad: dar — give! (imperative 2nd pl.; dad manero a qui las dé 'name a proxy to give them away', Pidal 'designad un representante'; = dad)
manero: manero — representative, proxy, one empowered to act for another (masc. noun; dad manero a qui las dé 'name a proxy to give them away'; Pidal 'designad un representante' o apoderado; more usually dar por manero a uno; = representante, apoderado)
dé: dar — (who) may give (present subjunctive 3rd sg., in a relative clause of purpose; a qui las dé 'to someone who is to give them'; = dé)
tomades: tomar — you take (present 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos las tomades 'since it is you who take them'; = tomáis)
alabarán: alabar — they will boast, brag (future 3rd pl., reflexive; dend non se alabarán 'they will not boast of it'; = se alabarán, se jactarán)
respondió: responder — he answered (preterite 3rd sg.; respondió el rey 'the king answered'; = respondió)
prendellas: prender + las — take them (imperative 2nd pl. prended + las, the -d- assimilated to l: prended + las > prendellas; prendellas con vuestras manos 'take them with your own hands'; = prendedlas, tomadlas)
daldas: dar + las — give them (imperative 2nd pl. dad + las, with the d and l changed round, dadlas > daldas; daldas a los ifantes 'give them to the Infantes'; = dadlas)
daquent: daquent — here, from here (de + aquent, a form of aquende 'on this side'; assí commo yo las prendo daquent 'just as I take them from here'; Pidal 'aquí'; = de aquí)
sed: seer — be! (imperative 2nd pl.; sed padrino dellas 'be their sponsor'; = sed)
padrino: padrino — sponsor, the man who stands by the bride and gives her at the wedding (masc. noun; sed padrino dellas 'act as their sponsor'; = padrino)
velar: velar — the veiling, the nuptial blessing (infinitive used as a noun, el velar; a tod el velar 'through the whole of the veiling'; Pidal 'la ceremonia de las velaciones'; = las velaciones)
juntáredes: juntar — (when) you meet, join (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos juntáredes comigo 'when you come together with me'; = juntareis, juntéis)
verdat: verdat — truth (fem. noun; quem digades la verdat 'that you tell me the truth'; = verdad)
oviemos: aver — we had (preterite 1st pl., strong; destas vistas que oviemos 'of this meeting that we have had'; = hubimos, tuvimos)
tomedes: tomar — (that) you take (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending, a polite request; de mí tomedes algo 'take something from me'; = toméis)
tráyovos: traer + vos — I bring you (present 1st sg. trayo, the old form beside traigo, + enclitic vos; tráyovos treínta palafrés 'I bring you thirty palfreys'; = os traigo)
enssellados: enssellar — saddled (past part. masc. pl. as adjective; cavallos … bien enssellados 'horses well saddled'; = ensillados)
enbargado: enbargar — overwhelmed, weighed down (past part.; mucho me avedes enbargado 'you have greatly overwhelmed me', with so many attentions; Pidal embargado 'abrumado' a fuerza de atenciones; = abrumado)
plazer: plazer — pleasure, favour, kindness (noun; este plazer quem feches 'this favour you do me'; = placer)
galardonado: galardonar — rewarded (past part. masc. sg. in a subjunctive clause; que bien sea galardonado 'that it be well rewarded'; = galardonado)
servido: servir — served, well served (past part.; de vos bien so servido 'I am well served by you'; = servido)
tengon: tener + me — I hold myself (present 1st sg. tengo + enclitic me cut to -m and written n; tengon por pagado 'I hold myself satisfied'; Pidal 'téngome'; = me tengo)
sediendo: seer — being, while being (gerund of seer 'to be, sit', with -iendo; aun bivo sediendo 'while I am still alive'; = siendo)
parto: partir — I depart, leave (present 1st sg., reflexive sense with me; destas vistas me parto 'I take my leave of this meeting'; = me parto, me voy)
ponga: poner — (may) he set, put (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; que lo ponga en buen recabdo 'may he put it in good order'; = ponga)
sobrel: sobre + el — upon the (the two e's run together; sobrel so cavallo 'upon his horse'; = sobre el)
daquend: daquend — from here (de + aquend, variant of daquent; daquend vaya comigo 'let him go with me from here'; = de aquí, desde aquí)
escurra: escurrir — (that) he escort, see off a departing guest some way on the road (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non quiere quel escurra 'he does not want him to see him off', Pidal 'no quiere que salga a despedirle', comp. escurriólos, v. 1067; = acompañe, despida)
dessí: dessí — thereupon, from there (des + í 'there'; dessí luégo[l] quitó 'right there he parted from him', Pidal 'allí mismo se separó de él'; = desde allí, allí mismo)
andantes: andante — fortunate (adjective, masc. pl., from andar; bien andantes 'fortunate, prosperous'; = afortunados)
espedirse: espedirse — to take leave (infinitive with enclitic se; besar las manos, espedirse de rey Alfons 'to kiss his hands, to take leave of King Alfonso'; = despedirse)
fazednos: fazer + nos — do for us (imperative 2nd pl. fazed + enclitic nos; fazednos este perdón 'forgive us this', Pidal 'perdonadnos esto'; = hacednos)
hiremos: ir — we shall go (future 1st pl., the h- only a spelling; hiremos en poder de mio Çid 'we shall go under my Çid's command'; = iremos)
soltó: soltar — he let go, released (preterite 3rd sg.; a todos los soltó 'he let them all go', Pidal 'dejó marchar libremente'; = dejó marchar)
mengó: menguar — it dwindled, grew smaller (preterite 3rd sg.; la del rey mengó 'the king's (company) dwindled'; = menguó)
ganó: ganar — he won, conquered (preterite 3rd sg.; la que en buen punto ganó 'which he won in a good hour'; = ganó)
fernando: Fernando — Fernando, one of the two Infantes of Carrión (also Ferrando; = Fernando)
diago: Diago — Diego, one of the two Infantes of Carrión (Pidal prints Di[a]go with the a supplied; also Di[da]go; = Diego)
mañas: maña — quality, trait of character, habit (fem. pl.; sopiessen sus mañas 'they were to learn their ways', the Infantes' character; = mañas, here manera de ser)
ansuor: Ansuor — Asur (Pidal's form; A[n]su[o]r with letters supplied), Asur González, elder brother of the Infantes of Carrión (Pidal; = Asur)
gonçálvez: Gonçálvez — González, patronymic 'son of Gonçalo' (Gonçál[v]ez, the v supplied; here Asur González; = González)
bullidor: bullidor — rowdy, a stirrer, a noisy fellow (adjective as noun, from bullir 'to stir, bustle'; que era bullidor 'who was a stirrer'; Pidal 'bullanguero'; = bullanguero)
largo: largo — long (adjective; largo de lengua 'long of tongue', a loose talker; = largo)
lengua: lengua — tongue, speech (fem. noun; largo de lengua 'free with his tongue'; = lengua)
afelos: afé + los — behold them (afé, presentative 'behold' + los; afelos en Valençia 'there they are in Valencia'; = helos aquí; origin of afé uncertain)
assomaron: assomar — they appeared, came into view (preterite 3rd pl.; quando a ella assomaron 'when they came in sight of it'; = asomaron)
mayores: mayor — greater, the greater (comparative adj. of grande, pl.; los gozos son mayores 'the joys are greater'; = mayores)
reyal: reyal — quarters, lodging (masc. noun; dad les un reyal 'give them quarters'; Pidal 'real, albergue'; = real, alojamiento)
apuntare: apuntar — (when) it breaks, dawns (future subjunctive 3rd sg., -are; que apuntare el sol 'when the sun comes up'; = apuntare, amanezca)
esposas: esposa — betrothed, bride (fem. pl.; verán a sus esposas 'they will see their brides'; = esposas)
veamos: veer — (that) we may see (present subjunctive 1st pl., optative; muchos dias vos veamos 'may we see you for many days'; = veamos)
adugo: aduzir — I bring (present 1st sg., -go as in digo; yernos vos adugo 'I bring you sons-in-law'; Pidal vos adugo 'os traigo'; = traigo)
gradídmelo: gradir + me + lo — thank me for it (imperative 2nd pl. gradid + me + lo, stress accent marked; gradídmelo, mis fijas 'thank me for it, my daughters'; me is dative 'to me'; = agradecédmelo)

__broaden__.afé: afé — behold, here is (presentative particle, used before a noun; afé Dios del çielo 'behold God of heaven'; = he aquí; origin uncertain) · also before a que-clause 'behold, (it is so) that' (afé que me plaz 'behold, it pleases me')
__broaden__.pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing' · also pro — profit, advantage, benefit (grant pro les fazié 'he did them great good, was of great profit to them') · also pro — useful, of worth (adjective; en lo al non es tan pro 'in other things he is not so worthy')
__broaden__.puesto: poner — set (past part.; non era puesto el sol 'the sun had not set'; = puesto) · also puesto — agreed, arranged (tod esto es puesto 'all this is settled'; = acordado)
__broaden__.quitó: quitar — he left, quit, gave up (preterite 3rd sg.; quitó a Alcoçer 'he left Alcocer'; = dejó, abandonó) · also quitar — he parted from, took leave of a person (luégo[l] quitó 'at once he took leave of him'; = se separó de)
__broaden__.luégol: luego + l(e) — at once it (luego + le; le probably takes up el campo as object, an odd use, so not certain; luégol atravessavan 'at once they crossed it'; = luego lo atravesaban; the accent shows the stress stays on lué-) · also luego + l(e) — at once … from him, dative of separation (dessí luégo[l] quitó 'right there he parted from him')
__broaden__.he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he) · also he — and (a spelling of e; he de fijas de mio Çid 'and of the daughters of my Çid')
__broaden__.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese) · also seer — I were (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg.; commo si fosse delant 'as if I were present')
__broaden__.pero: Pero — Peter (San Pero = San Pedro, the saint of the monastery) · also Pero — Pedro, Per Vermudoz (don Pero, the Cid's vassal)
__broaden__.sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain) · also Sol — doña Sol, one of the Cid's two daughters (personal name)
